content.title: Fuel Rewards: Pay less for gas through everyday purchases
content.text: about Lower the price of everyday life. support You have questions? We have answers. New Fuel Rewards® members save 10¢/gal* on your first fill, 20¢/gal* on your second fill, and 30¢/gal* on your third fill! Offer valid at participating Shell stations within 60 days of signing up. Platinum Status Save at least 10¢/gal†, earn 2X on select In-Store Rewards‡, and access special VIP experiences. Our most rewarding tier of the program. To earn Platinum Status, fill up at Shell 12 times with 10 gallons or more in 3 months. Each fill-up with V-Power® NiTRO+ Premium Gasoline counts as 2 fills. Learn More Gold Status Save at least 5¢/gal† on every fill-up. New Fuel Rewards® members enjoy Complimentary Gold Status for an introductory period. To maintain Gold Status, fill up 6 times in 3 months. Qualifying fill-ups must be 10 gallons or more. Learn More Silver Status Save at least 3¢/gal† on every fill-up. Fuel Rewards® Members enjoy everyday savings at Shell with Silver Status. Qualifying fill-ups must be 10 gallons or more. Learn More More Ways to Earn Keep Earning, Keep Saving at the Pump. Whenever you shop, dine, or make other everyday purchases with any of the Fuel Rewards® program's participating merchants and restaurants, you'll earn valuable cents-per-gallon discounts on fuel at Shell known as Fuel Rewards® Savings. Stack & Save Stack these savings with your Member Status savings to drive down the price you pay at the pump even further. Here's an example of how easily you can save 35¢/gal: Earn 10¢/gal from Fuel Rewards® Dining; Save another 15¢/gal from shopping online Stacked with your 10¢/gal Platinum Status savings. Ways to Earn Use a Fuel Rewards® card, Alt ID, or a credit card opted into Link & Save™ to lower your fuel price at participating Shell stations. See How It Works Join / Log In FAQs *Restrictions apply. Offer valid from April 21, 2025, through December 31, 2026 (the "Offer Period"). Under this offer, net new Fuel Rewards® members can earn up to three rewards: (1) a one-time reward of 10¢/gal on your first fill-up; (2) a one-time reward of 20¢/gal on your second fill-up; and (3) a one-time reward of 30¢/gal on your third fill-up (collectively, the "New Member Acquisition Rewards"). All New Member Acquisition Rewards must be redeemed within 60 days of joining the Fuel Rewards® program (the "Offer Time Frame"). The New Member Acquisition Rewards savings are inclusive of your new member Complimentary Gold Status savings of 5¢/gal. Visit www.fuelrewards.com/status for complete tier status terms and conditions. To qualify for the first 10¢/gal reward, you must (i) join the Fuel Rewards® program as a net new member during the Offer Period, and (ii) swipe your Fuel Rewards® card, use a linked payment card, or enter your Alt ID when fueling at a participating Shell station when completing your first fill-up within the Offer Time Frame. To earn the second 20¢/gal reward, you must: (i) swipe your Fuel Rewards® card, use a linked payment card, or enter your Alt ID when fueling at a participating Shell station within the Offer Time Frame, and (ii) have previously completed your first fill-up . To qualify for the third 30¢/gal reward, you must: (i) swipe your Fuel Rewards® card, use a linked payment card, or enter your Alt ID when fueling at a participating Shell station within the Offer Time Frame, and (ii) have previously completed your second fill-up. The New Member Acquisition Rewards for your first fill-up, second fill-up and third fill-up expire 60 days after you have registered for the Fuel Rewards® program. It may not be possible to combine multiple discounts and/or rewards in a single transaction. The New Member Acquisition Rewards are limited to three redemptions as outlined above. Each New Member Acquisition Reward may take up to 24 hours to post to your Fuel Rewards® account. This offer is valid only for net new Fuel Rewards® members and may not be combined with any other acquisition rewards. *Restrictions apply. Visit www.fuelrewards.com/status for full tier status terms. Void where prohibited, only available in US. Unless otherwise specified in the applicable offer terms, Fuel Rewards® savings are limited to 20 gallons of fuel per purchase per vehicle or fraud limits placed by Shell and/or limits placed on your payment card by your financial institution, each of which may be lower. Dispenser may require a price of up to $0.109/gallon. Once you begin to dispense fuel using your Fuel Rewards® savings, you must dispense to the applicable offer's gallon limit or you forfeit any remaining discounted gallons of fuel. If rewards from multiple offers are combined in a redemption, the lowest gallon limit for such offers will apply. If you have a rewards balance greater than the current per-gallon price of fuel, the price will roll down to the maximum capability of the fuel equipment, and your remaining rewards will be saved for a future fuel purchase. For purchases of $75 or more, please go inside to pay. Unbranded diesel and alternative fuels may not be eligible. To learn more, visit www.fuelrewards.com/status or call (888) 603-0473. The Fuel Rewards® program is owned and operated by Equilon Enterprises LLC dba Shell Oil Products US. Offers may be modified or discontinued at any time without notice. Not valid where prohibited by law. Please see fuelrewards.com for complete Fuel Rewards® program details and Terms and Conditions. Other restrictions may apply.
